name: agent-watch
description: A themeable Windows home for your local coding agents.
author: William Pyle

scripts.build: npm run themes:check && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
First Windows desktop release.

- Robot Datacenter included: six robots, individual charging homes, workstations, printers, data interfaces, server racks and a controller monitor wall.
- Download Mooseville and Orbital Station from the built-in GitHub theme library.
- Customize graphics, characters, idle rotations, activities and action/tool mappings with personal theme copies.
- Startup app and theme updates; restart when ready to install an app update.
- Local Codex and Claude observation with clearly labeled preview mode.

Download Agent-Watch-Setup-0.1.0-x64.exe below. This initial build is unsigned.

Validation: 19 unit tests, desktop and packaged-app checks, fixture observation, and verified GitHub theme downloads.
